title: solver
intro: A way to solve the matrix equation ’A x = b’.

sections.name: cxsparse
sections.desc:
Solve equation using CXSparse library described in:
    Direct Methods for Sparse Linear Systems, T. A. Davis, SIAM, Philadelphia,
Sept. 2006. Part of the SIAM Book Series on the Fundamentals of Algorithms.
    The uBLAS interface was provided by Gunter Winkler <guwi17@gmx.de>.
sections.used: heatrect Mollerup solver (see 46.1, page 229) , transport Mollerup solver (see 92.2, page 489) , uzrect Mollerup solver (see 99.1, page 539) , and svat SSOC solver (see 88.2, page 476) .
